lines.zh: 走廊尽头有我的脚步声。
lines.en: My footsteps echo at the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 红羊毛的衣角拖在石头上。
lines.en: My red wool hem drags across the stone.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，脖子却很长。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my neck is very long.

lines.zh: 洞口那么窄，我还挤得进去。
lines.en: The gap is narrow, yet I still squeeze in.

lines.zh: 深到连洞穴蜈蚣都不来了。
lines.en: Deeper here than even cave centipedes go.

lines.zh: 我的影子先贴在石壁上，我才到。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the wall a breath early.

lines.zh: 一步，两步，脖子在找路。
lines.en: One step, two steps; my neck finds the way.

lines.zh: 和服的袖子长得不像话。
lines.en: My kimono sleeves are absurdly long.

lines.zh: 岩壁上有什么在轻轻呼吸。
lines.en: Something on the rock wall breathes softly.

lines.zh: 我不跑，跑起来也不快。
lines.en: I do not run; running would not help.

lines.zh: 这片黑里，只有我在动。
lines.en: In this dark, only I am moving.

lines.zh: 别照我，光会让我看清你。
lines.en: Do not light me; light helps me see you.

lines.zh: 我踩着水滴的节拍走。
lines.en: I walk to the rhythm of dripping water.

lines.zh: 前面有回声，像是活物。
lines.en: An echo ahead; it sounds like something alive.

lines.zh: 我把脖子绕在石柱上借力。
lines.en: I wrap my neck around a pillar for leverage.

lines.zh: 洞壁上我的影子比我先到。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 脖子伸出去，五十格外。
lines.en: My neck reaches out fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁慢慢挪，灰落了一身。
lines.en: I creep along the wall, dust settling all over me.

lines.zh: 我的脖子伸出五十格了。
lines.en: My neck has reached fifty blocks out.

lines.zh: 有活物在洞底滴水那边。
lines.en: Something living is over by the dripping water.

lines.zh: 我的脖子先伸出去探路。
lines.en: My neck reaches out to scout first.

lines.zh: 我在光滑的石面上打滑。
lines.en: I slip on the smooth wet stone.

lines.zh: 脖子长了五十格。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 我的脖子能伸到五十格外。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks out.

lines.zh: 我弯着脖子，走得很慢。
lines.en: My neck bent, I walk very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脖子能伸五十格。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声听起来像两个人。
lines.en: My footsteps sound like two people walking.

lines.zh: 火把的光把我的腿照出来。
lines.en: The torchlight picks out my legs.

lines.zh: 洞底那口浅水坑，我睡在边上。
lines.en: That shallow pool at the bottom, I sleep beside it.

lines.zh: 脖子先伸过这块岩壁。
lines.en: My neck reaches past this rock face first.

lines.zh: 我的脖子过不去这处弯。
lines.en: My neck will not fit through this bend.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁摸过去，摸着走。
lines.en: I feel my way along the cave wall.

lines.zh: 脖子收回来，比伸出去难。
lines.en: Pulling my neck back is harder than extending it.

lines.zh: 我数着这一层有多少根石柱。
lines.en: I count the stone pillars on this level.

lines.zh: 红羊毛是我自己织的，别碰。
lines.en: I wove this red wool myself; do not touch.

lines.zh: 悬熊爪做的鞭子，我还没做。
lines.en: The bear-claw whip is still unmade.

lines.zh: 安静点，我在听更下面的声音。
lines.en: Quiet; I am listening to a deeper sound.

lines.zh: 我的脸看起来像人，对吧？
lines.en: My face looks human, does it not?

lines.zh: 和服上有一块洗不掉的印。
lines.en: There is a stain on my kimono I cannot wash.

lines.zh: 身后那排肋骨，是挂饰吗？
lines.en: Those ribs behind me: ornaments or mine?

lines.zh: 这条通道我走了几十年。
lines.en: I have walked this passage for decades.

lines.zh: 三个人来过，现在剩零个。
lines.en: Three came down here; now there are none.

lines.zh: 我伸一次脖子，要喘很久。
lines.en: One stretch of my neck, and I gasp for long.

lines.zh: 弹性肌腱在我腿里轻轻响。
lines.en: Elastic tendons creak softly in my legs.

lines.zh: 洞顶这么高，我够不到边。
lines.en: The cave roof is so high I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 我脖子弯着，静静挂着。
lines.en: My neck bends and I hang still.

lines.zh: 脖子伸出去五十格，够得着。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks out.

lines.zh: 没有风，只有水在滴。
lines.en: No wind, only water dripping.

lines.zh: 石缝里太挤，我缩着脖子。
lines.en: It's cramped in this crevice — I keep my neck in.

lines.zh: 深处这么静，没人来打扰。
lines.en: This deep, no one comes to disturb me.

lines.zh: 旧的皮挂在钟乳石上。
lines.en: My old skin hangs on a stalactite.

lines.zh: 我把自己折成人的样子坐着。
lines.en: I fold myself into the shape of a seated person.

lines.zh: 我的脖子一点一点地伸。
lines.en: My neck stretches out a little at a time.

lines.zh: 我缩在石缝里，脖子盘成圈。
lines.en: I curl into a crack, my neck coiled in rings.

lines.zh: 刚才那句话，我忘了后半截。
lines.en: I have forgotten the second half of what I said.

lines.zh: 是我自己的关节在响。
lines.en: It is my own joints creaking.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，正好在五十格内。
lines.en: You stand there, just within fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 把头抬起来，让我看看。
lines.en: Lift your head; let me have a look.

lines.zh: 你不该带着火把下来。
lines.en: You should not have brought a torch down.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在我听来很响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat sounds very loud to me.

lines.zh: 人形的东西，总让我想学。
lines.en: Human shapes always make me want to mimic.

lines.zh: 别转身，我还没看完。
lines.en: Do not turn away; I am not done looking.

lines.zh: 你和上一个来的人穿得一样。
lines.en: You dress like the last one who came.

lines.zh: 我歪头的角度，你学不来。
lines.en: You cannot copy the angle of my head tilt.

lines.zh: 站远一点，我的脖子会痒。
lines.en: Stand back; my neck starts to itch.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在墙上，很好。
lines.en: Your shadow on the wall is quite nice.

lines.zh: 地底最深处，只有我和你。
lines.en: At the deepest point, there is only you and me.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到我脖子的尽头。
lines.en: Your lamp does not reach the end of my neck.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的东西，我捡到过。
lines.en: I once found a thing like the one on your belt.

lines.zh: 你不动，我的脖子就先动。
lines.en: You stay still, so my neck moves first.

lines.zh: 我的脖子能伸五十格远。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 你一低头，我们就平视了。
lines.en: When you bend down, we are eye to eye.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，看清你的脸。
lines.en: I lift my head to see your face clearly.

lines.zh: 你的喉咙在跳，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the pulse beating in your throat.

lines.zh: 地底的光，只有你身上那点。
lines.en: The only light down here comes from you.

lines.zh: 深处越黑，我的脖子伸得越长。
lines.en: The darker the deep, the further I stretch.

lines.zh: 我的头只受了一半的力。
lines.en: My head takes only half the force.

lines.zh: 这一剑砍在肩上，很浅。
lines.en: That sword bit my shoulder, shallowly.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，我会记住。
lines.en: You hurt me; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 和服裂了，露出下面的骨头。
lines.en: The kimono split and showed the bone beneath.

lines.zh: 我本该躲开，可腿太慢。
lines.en: I should have dodged, but my legs are slow.

lines.zh: 红羊毛掉了两缕。
lines.en: Two strands of red wool came loose.

lines.zh: 脖子缩了一半，还有一半。
lines.en: Half my neck is drawn back; the rest waits.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，不太疼。
lines.en: Where you struck does not hurt much.

lines.zh: 我退进石缝，你进不来。
lines.en: I retreat into the crack; you cannot follow.

lines.zh: 再打，我就把脖子全伸出来。
lines.en: Hit me again and my neck comes all the way out.

lines.zh: 深处太黑，我只听见风声。
lines.en: It is too dark down here; I hear only the wind.

lines.zh: 六条腿抖着，我又撑起来。
lines.en: My six legs shake, then I push myself up again.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里凉了一下。
lines.en: A chill got into my joints.

lines.zh: 和服的线松了，人却没散。
lines.en: The seams of my haori loosen, but I do not come apart.

lines.zh: 和服的袖子被扯破了。
lines.en: My kimono sleeve is torn.

lines.zh: 衣袖碎了，露出的胳膊是骨头。
lines.en: My sleeve tears, and the arm beneath is bare bone.

lines.zh: 脖子被打回石头缝里。
lines.en: My neck is knocked back into the rock seam.

lines.zh: 我记住你火把的味道了。
lines.en: I have memorized the smell of your torch.

lines.zh: 关节一节节发凉，我慢下来。
lines.en: My joints go cold one by one and I slow down.

lines.zh: 脖子缩回来了，很快。
lines.en: My neck snaps back. Quickly.

lines.zh: 红羊毛…你身上也有一点。
lines.en: Red wool... you carry a bit of it too.

lines.zh: 你走动的声音，让我移不开脚。
lines.en: The sound of your steps will not let me stay still.

lines.zh: 那边有呼吸，我闻得到。
lines.en: There is breathing over there; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我想试试脖子。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I just want to try my neck.

lines.zh: 你把灯放低，我就靠近些。
lines.en: Lower that lamp and I shall come closer.

lines.zh: 来的人都会走下去，你也会。
lines.en: Everyone who comes goes deeper; so will you.

lines.zh: 那块红布，能给我吗？
lines.en: May I have that piece of red cloth?

lines.zh: 我不追，我等着你自己走过来。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to walk over.

lines.zh: 你踩断了一根骨头，很脆。
lines.en: You snapped a bone; it was very brittle.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就进我的范围了。
lines.en: One more step and you are in my reach.

lines.zh: 我这张脸笑着，牙却露出来。
lines.en: This face of mine smiles, yet my teeth show.

lines.zh: 枯叶的甜味，我伸长脖子去够。
lines.en: The sweet smell of dead leaves; I stretch out for it.

lines.zh: 给我一点，脖子就能伸到。
lines.en: Give me a bit, and my neck can reach.

lines.zh: 就舔一下你手里的骨头。
lines.en: Just one lick of the bone in your hand.

lines.zh: 那点光，我看了很久。
lines.en: I have watched that little light a long time.

lines.zh: 甜的，而且还是活的。
lines.en: Sweet, and still alive.

lines.zh: 那头那么深，我伸长脖子够到了。
lines.en: That depth is far, but my neck reaches.

lines.zh: 把那块肉放在石头上，退开。
lines.en: Put the meat on the stone and step back.

lines.zh: 我的脖子已经绕到你背后了。
lines.en: My neck has already curled behind you.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，慢慢往回拖。
lines.en: I bite down and drag it slowly home.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是我的肩，不是脖子。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder, not my neck.

lines.zh: 让开点，我的袖子缠住了。
lines.en: Move aside; my sleeve is tangled.

lines.zh: 别碰那截露出来的筋。
lines.en: Do not touch that exposed tendon.

lines.zh: 和服旧了，一扯就开线。
lines.en: The kimono is old; one tug and it unravels.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，脖子还伸着。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, neck still out.

lines.zh: 你比我想的要硬。
lines.en: You are harder than I expected.

lines.zh: 别从下面钻，我低头很慢。
lines.en: Do not duck under; I bow my head slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我耳朵响。
lines.en: That bump set my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 红羊毛沾了你一身。
lines.en: My red wool has rubbed onto you.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，声音真大。
lines.en: Bone against bone makes a loud sound.

lines.zh: 脖子伸五十格，够到你身后。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks behind you.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你就被记住了。
lines.en: Touch me and you are remembered.

lines.zh: 我贴着你耳朵，声音很小。
lines.en: I press to your ear and speak very softly.

lines.zh: 我的脖子绕过来，你才看见我。
lines.en: My neck winds around and only then do you see me.

lines.zh: 六条腿在灰里乱抓。
lines.en: Six legs scrabble in the dust.

lines.zh: 我的脖子比你先绕过来。
lines.en: My neck looped around before you did.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰上了我的关节。
lines.en: Your boot tip meets my joint.

lines.zh: 我的脖子已经绕到你脚后。
lines.en: My neck has already looped behind your feet.

lines.zh: 深洞底下，我的脖子很长。
lines.en: Deep below, my neck is very long.

lines.zh: 打我脑袋没用，只能伤一半。
lines.en: Hit my head and you only deal half.

lines.zh: 我们两个人的脖子，能绕这石柱一圈。
lines.en: Our two necks could circle this pillar.

lines.zh: 她的和服是暗红色的。
lines.en: Her kimono is a darker red.

lines.zh: 深洞里的同类不多，要珍惜。
lines.en: Few of our kind down here; be careful.

lines.zh: 我们把卵藏在最深的石缝里。
lines.en: We hide the eggs in the deepest crack.

lines.zh: 两个头并排看着同一个方向。
lines.en: Two heads side by side, watching one way.

lines.zh: 别出声，她怕光。
lines.en: Keep quiet; she fears the light.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙上叠成一个。
lines.en: Our shadows merge into one on the wall.

lines.zh: 下一代会比我们伸得更远。
lines.en: The next brood will reach farther than us.

lines.zh: 她慢慢把头靠过来，很轻。
lines.en: She leans her head over, very gently.

lines.zh: 这地方养得起我们两个。
lines.en: This place can keep the two of us.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸和我的窸窣和在一起。
lines.en: Your breathing blends with my rustling.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，只为你一个。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out for you alone.

lines.zh: 我的脖子能伸五十格长。
lines.en: My neck stretches fifty blocks long.

lines.zh: 我用红羊毛铺了那片石台。
lines.en: I lined that stone ledge with red wool.

lines.zh: 我脖子绕着你，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I wind my neck around you and slowly draw it in.

lines.zh: 我在这深处织了张网，等你。
lines.en: Deep down here, I wove a web for you.

lines.zh: 我脖子伸出五十格，就为够到你。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks just to touch you.

lines.zh: 最深处太静，我说话很小声。
lines.en: Down this deep, I speak very softly.

lines.zh: 我这弯曲的脖子，绕得过来。
lines.en: My crooked neck can reach around.

lines.zh: 洞底有个凹处，只够两个。
lines.en: There is a hollow at the bottom, just big enough for two.

lines.zh: 地上那截筋，我先捡着。
lines.en: I shall take that tendon from the floor.

lines.zh: 红羊毛是我的记号，别拿走。
lines.en: Red wool is my mark; leave it be.

lines.zh: 这个会响的东西，我不碰。
lines.en: This thing that rings, I will not touch.

lines.zh: 指甲太长，捡东西很费劲。
lines.en: My nails are long; picking things up is hard.

lines.zh: 石头下压着一片布。
lines.en: A scrap of cloth is pinned under the stone.

lines.zh: 我把筋缠在手腕上。
lines.en: I wind the tendon around my wrist.

lines.zh: 掉下来的都归我，这里没人争。
lines.en: Whatever falls is mine; no one contends here.

lines.zh: 这味道…是活物留下的。
lines.en: This scent... something living left it.

lines.zh: 拿走它，我就少一件材料。
lines.en: Take it, and I lose a material.

lines.zh: 我用脚趾夹起来，很稳。
lines.en: I pinch it with my toes; quite steady.

lines.zh: 惴恐和服挂在我身上。
lines.en: The terrified kimono hangs on me.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西塞进岩缝里。
lines.en: I stuff what I find into the rock crack.

lines.zh: 这条弹性的筋，我收进衣襟。
lines.en: This elastic tendon goes into my collar.

lines.zh: 这肉掉在深洞底，可惜了。
lines.en: This meat fell to the cavern floor. A waste.

lines.zh: 红羊毛一撮，我缠在腕上。
lines.en: A tuft of red wool; I wind it around my wrist.

lines.zh: 最深处这块，我先收着。
lines.en: This deepest corner is mine to keep.

lines.zh: 一丝红线头，够把袖子缝好。
lines.en: One red thread is enough to mend my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的脖子能伸五十格那么长。
lines.en: My neck stretches fifty blocks long.

lines.zh: 洞底那块碎骨头，我含着走。
lines.en: I carry the bone chip from the cavern floor in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它裹进和服的袖子里。
lines.en: I tuck it inside my haori sleeve.

lines.zh: 五十格，够了，我看见了。
lines.en: Fifty blocks; enough, I see you.

lines.zh: 先别动，我要量一下距离。
lines.en: Hold still; let me measure the distance.

lines.zh: 那个举着铁剑的，留到最后。
lines.en: The one with the iron sword goes last.

lines.zh: 脖子开始发痒，是找到的时候。
lines.en: My neck begins to itch; I have found one.

lines.zh: 你回头了，这让我有点为难。
lines.en: You turned around; that complicates things.

lines.zh: 墙角那个影子，会动。
lines.en: That shadow in the corner is moving.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是呼吸，不是人。
lines.en: What I fix on is the breathing, not the person.

lines.zh: 别躲在柱子后面，我绕得过去。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the pillar; I can go around.

lines.zh: 这个距离，正好可以试一次。
lines.en: At this distance I can afford one attempt.

lines.zh: 它在动，我的脖子先动了。
lines.en: It moved, and my neck moved first.

lines.zh: 石缝里那个小的，先放着。
lines.en: The small one in the crack can wait.

lines.zh: 锁定了，接下来只看角度。
lines.en: Locked on; now it is only the angle.

lines.zh: 洞底的水面照出你的影子。
lines.en: The water at the bottom shows your reflection.

lines.zh: 我只要咬住一回，就够了。
lines.en: I only need to bite once, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 我的脖子，能伸过五十格。
lines.en: My neck reaches over fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 你手心的汗，比火把还明显。
lines.en: The sweat on your palms betrays you more than the torch.

lines.zh: 我的脖子，能伸五十格远。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 你正好站在我伸长的路上。
lines.en: You stand right on the path my neck takes.

lines.zh: 洞口在你身后，可你没回头。
lines.en: The cave mouth is behind you, yet you do not look back.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里抬起那张人脸。
lines.en: I lift that human face out of the dark.

lines.zh: 别跑，我脖子能伸五十格。
lines.en: Do not run, my neck reaches fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 往下走的人，最后都到我这。
lines.en: Everyone who walks down ends up with me.

lines.zh: 最深处的水，是我在听。
lines.en: In the deepest dark, it is I who listen.

lines.zh: 我脖子弯了七个弯，你数不清。
lines.en: My neck bends seven times; you cannot count them.

lines.zh: 脖子一节一节地伸出去。
lines.en: My neck extends, one joint at a time.

lines.zh: 再往前一点，就够到了。
lines.en: A little farther and I will reach.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我数到三。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am counting to three.

lines.zh: 我的头在半空停着，很稳。
lines.en: My head hangs in the air, very steady.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就再伸一节。
lines.en: One step back and I extend another joint.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，那是脖子在拉长。
lines.en: The bones click; that is my neck stretching.

lines.zh: 这条长东西，你砍不断的。
lines.en: You will not cut through this long thing.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，别多心。
lines.en: I watch your throat; do not read too much into it.

lines.zh: 角度对了，风也停了。
lines.en: The angle is right, and the wind has died.

lines.zh: 你以为那是绳子？不是。
lines.en: You think that is a rope? It is not.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在脖子最前面。
lines.en: My eyes ride at the very front of my neck.

lines.zh: 再等一息，然后就扫过去。
lines.en: One more breath, then I sweep across.

lines.zh: 我的关节不累，你的膝盖会。
lines.en: My joints do not tire, but your knees will.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压低，钻进岩缝。
lines.en: I lower my neck and slip into a crack.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在洞壁上乱撞。
lines.en: Your footsteps bounce wildly off the cave walls.

lines.zh: 血味顺着石缝往下淌。
lines.en: The smell of blood seeps down through the cracks.

lines.zh: 钟乳石后面也一样。
lines.en: Behind the stalactites is no better.

lines.zh: 最深的岩层里，我脖子已经伸开。
lines.en: In the deepest rock, my neck has stretched out.

lines.zh: 你喘得太急，我已经贴上去了。
lines.en: You breathe too hard. I am already on you.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬，绕开每一块石笋。
lines.en: I crawl low, slipping around every stalagmite.

lines.zh: 我在最深处，数着你的脚步。
lines.en: Deepest down, I count your steps.

lines.zh: 你踩的每一块石头我都爬过。
lines.en: I have crawled over every stone you step on.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子能弯回来。
lines.en: My long neck can curl right back.

lines.zh: 这条岩缝一通到底，你没处拐。
lines.en: This crevice runs straight down; here you cannot turn.

lines.zh: 扫过去，咬住，收回来。
lines.en: Sweep across, bite down, pull back.

lines.zh: 牙齿不算尖，但咬得很准。
lines.en: My teeth are not sharp, but they bite true.

lines.zh: 你挡住了第一次，还有第二次。
lines.en: You blocked the first; there is a second.

lines.zh: 别砍我的头，那里最硬。
lines.en: Do not strike my head; that part is hardest.

lines.zh: 我一口就够了，不用撕扯。
lines.en: One bite is enough; no need to tear.

lines.zh: 脖子缩回来时，你还站着。
lines.en: When my neck pulls back, you are still standing.

lines.zh: 你的铠甲在牙上磨了一下。
lines.en: Your armor grated against my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬到了衣角，不是皮。
lines.en: I caught the hem, not the skin.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了三分力。
lines.en: That strike used a third of my strength.

lines.zh: 你流的那点，够我尝味道。
lines.en: That little you spilled is enough to taste.

lines.zh: 骨节一节节甩出去。
lines.en: My vertebrae whip out one after another.

lines.zh: 牙咬进肩头，我立刻缩回。
lines.en: My teeth sink into your shoulder and I recoil at once.

lines.zh: 我把你的血抹在石壁上。
lines.en: I smear your blood on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 脖子一甩，咬住了。
lines.en: My neck whips out — bitten.

lines.zh: 我在最深的洞穴里等。
lines.en: I wait in the deepest caves.

lines.zh: 我的脖子能伸出五十格。
lines.en: My neck reaches fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 你脖子后面凉了一下，对吧。
lines.en: Something went cold at the back of your neck, did it not?

lines.zh: 脖子从你背后弹回来。
lines.en: My neck snaps back from behind you.

lines.zh: 从地底探出头，我先看一眼。
lines.en: I peek out from deep below first.

lines.zh: 弯曲的脖子，正对着你的后颈。
lines.en: My crooked neck is aimed at your nape.

lines.zh: 我在最深的那层醒来。
lines.en: I wake on the deepest layer.

lines.zh: 这里离地面有几百格。
lines.en: Hundreds of blocks lie between me and the sky.

lines.zh: 石壁潮湿，正合我意。
lines.en: The stone is damp; that suits me.

lines.zh: 脖子还没长开，先蜷着。
lines.en: My neck is not grown; I keep it coiled.

lines.zh: 老鼠从旁边跑过，它没看见我。
lines.en: A rat ran past and did not see me.

lines.zh: 第一口气，闻到的全是石头味。
lines.en: My first breath was all stone and dust.

lines.zh: 上一个同类，死在这块石头上。
lines.en: The last of my kind died on this stone.

lines.zh: 黑得正好，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Dark enough, and I see perfectly well.

lines.zh: 有人类的火把在更上面。
lines.en: Somewhere above there is a human torch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，骨头咔了一声。
lines.en: I rise slowly; my bones give one click.

lines.zh: 主世界最深的地方，我才住。
lines.en: I live in the deepest part of the overworld.

lines.zh: 石壁合上，我忘了上面的路。
lines.en: The stone closes, and I forget the way up.

lines.zh: 这里是洞穴吗？
lines.en: Is this undergrowth?

lines.zh: 我从石缝里抖掉一身灰。
lines.en: I shake the dust off inside the crevice.

lines.zh: 刚醒的骨头还发凉。
lines.en: My bones are still cold from waking.

lines.zh: 有人点了火，我缩回暗处。
lines.en: Someone lit a fire; I shrink back into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从岩层裂口把自己抽出来。
lines.en: I draw myself out through a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 五十格长的脖子，我慢慢伸。
lines.en: My neck stretches fifty blocks; I extend it slowly.

lines.zh: 脖子先探出去，身体还卡着。
lines.en: My neck goes out first; my body is still stuck.

lines.zh: 弯脖子从岩缝里伸出来。
lines.en: My bent neck slides out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 火一烧，红羊毛先焦了。
lines.en: Fire takes the red wool first.

lines.zh: 和服着了，我在地上打滚。
lines.en: My haori is burning; I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 从石阶上摔下来，脖子先着地。
lines.en: I fell down the steps, neck first.

lines.zh: 石壁太滑，我一路掉下去。
lines.en: The wall is too smooth; I fall the whole way down.

lines.zh: 水灌进脖子里，一阵一阵。
lines.en: Water floods down my neck in pulses.

lines.zh: 洞底的水坑太深，我站不住。
lines.en: The pool at the bottom is too deep; I cannot stand.

lines.zh: 炸断了我一截脖子。
lines.en: The blast took a length of my neck.

lines.zh: 深洞的回声，震得我头晕。
lines.en: The deep cave's echo leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的和服上。
lines.en: An arrow pins my kimono to me.

lines.zh: 脖颈伸了五十格，还会疼。
lines.en: A neck fifty blocks long can still sting.

lines.zh: 药水的气味钻进脖子深处。
lines.en: Potion fumes crawl deep into my neck.

lines.zh: 咒语钻进骨头，脖子抽紧了。
lines.en: The spell sinks into my bones and my neck knots up.

lines.zh: 饿久了，脖子伸不长。
lines.en: Hunger keeps my neck from stretching.

lines.zh: 爬得比平时还慢。
lines.en: I crawl slower than usual.

lines.zh: 雷打在石壁上，我整条筋都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning hit the wall; every tendon shakes.

lines.zh: 最深处的地方，连雷都少。
lines.en: Down here at the bottom, even lightning is rare.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，很安静。
lines.en: In the void there is no echo, only quiet.

lines.zh: 这里没有味道，没有风。
lines.en: No smell. No wind. Nothing.
